name: Merlin
rootCause: MerlinLabs, the DeFi revenue aggregator, was attacked. The attack method was similar to that of PancakeBunny, which was attacked by lightning loan 5 days ago, and lost US$6.8 million.

descriptions.text: The PancakeBunny attack pulled the rabbit out of the hat, now a surprisingly similar string of attacks emerges from Binance Smart Chain. $680,000 taken from Merlin Lab.
Once was not enough for Merlin Labs. Just 8 hours after the first attack, they lost another ~200 ETH, yet still they remain at the bottom of the leaderboard. Must try harder.
MerlinLabs, the DeFi revenue aggregator, was attacked. The attack method was similar to that of PancakeBunny, which was attacked by lightning loan 5 days ago, and lost US$6.8 million.
